_comment: The workflow registry. A capability is an entry here, not code: build the
graph in ComfyUI, export it with Save (API Format) into this directory,
add an entry, restart. No backend changes.
Node IDs are brittle -- they change if a graph is rebuilt in the editor --
so every template is versioned in its filename and every binding below is
checked against the template at boot. A mismatch fails loudly at startup,
never silently at generation time. Run `alchemyui validate` to check by
hand, or `alchemyui validate --live` to also ask a running ComfyUI whether
the node classes and checkpoints actually exist.

defaults.negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, signature, deformed hands, extra limbs

txt2img-sdxl._est_note: Seeds the ETA until real runs are observed, then an EWMA takes over. seconds_per_step is measured on a GTX 1660 Ti Mobile (6GB, --fp8_e4m3fn-unet): SDXL 1024x1024 x25 steps = ~131s wall. load_s is deliberately conservative -- an observed 3.8s was a page-cache-warm read, not a cold one.
